invariant:
ADR-0055 §1 — a `controlled_by_parent` object derives its master from EXACTLY ONE `master_detail` field declared `required: true`, and the parse refuses anything else (`refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster`, in `ObjectSchemaBase`'s superRefine): no such field (a non-required `master_detail`, a required `lookup`, nothing) at `sharingModel`, two or more at `fields`. It runs on the PARSE, not only in `ObjectSchema.create()`, because the shapes it refuses were reachable through every door that skips the builder and the security runtime derives no master from them — so an object the parse accepted would be denied every read and refused every write. Do NOT move it back to `create()` only, and do NOT accept a second tier here (any `master_detail`, a required `lookup`): the runtime's two fallback tiers were retired under ADR-0049 with the step-18 semantic migration `cbp-master-relation-tiers-retired`, and a parse wider than the runtime is the three-seam disagreement that retirement closed.

`IndexSchema.unique` scope contract (ADR-0120 D1, amending #3696): `'global'` = verbatim columns (no organization column injected); `'organization'` = the driver prepends the NULL-safe organization key part (COALESCE(organization_id, '__global__')) at registration; bare `true` = REFUSED since protocol 18 (#5082, ADR-0120 D7) with a prescription naming both words — it was the positional spelling of `'global'`; stored and built metadata converts it to `'global'` through the ADR-0087 conversion `declared-index-unique-scope` (byte-identical physical index), retired from the authoring funnel so a live author is refused, never converted silently. Field-level `unique: true` stays valid (D1) — never narrow `UniqueScopeSchema` in step with this one. Do NOT re-broaden the describe() back to 'true and global are synonyms, list the tenant column yourself' — that is the #4986 trap, and the hand-written composite is not NULL-safe (#5030).

ADR-0144 D2 — a `record`-mode amount's `currencyConfig.currencyField` must name ANOTHER declared field of the same object whose type may carry a value domain (`VALUE_DOMAIN_FIELD_TYPES`, `text` today) and which declares `valueDomain: 'iso_4217_currency'` (`refuseDishonestRecordCurrencyField`, in `ObjectSchemaBase`'s superRefine beside `refuseNonPictureImageField`). It runs on the parse because only the object holds the sibling field map, and it covers a `formula` with `returnType: 'currency'` in the same shape. Do NOT accept a pointer into nothing, at a non-code field, or at a text field without the domain: each lets a write store an amount whose currency is any string or none. It is deliberately not run on `ObjectExtensionSchema`, whose pointer may name a field only the owner declares.

ADR-0144 D5 — a `record`-mode amount's `currencyConfig.homeAmount` is judged on the parse (`refuseDishonestHomeAmount`, beside `refuseDishonestRecordCurrencyField`): the amount itself is a stored `currency` field (never a `formula`); `field` names ANOTHER declared `currency` field in `dynamic` mode (D8 rule 5: metadata never names the home currency) that no other amount already stores into; `rateDate` a declared `date` / `datetime` field; `rateField` a declared `number` field, shared only by amounts with the same `currencyField` and `rateDate`. The home and rate fields are platform-written and say so with the EXISTING mark, `readonly: true`, and carry no `expression`. Do NOT invent a new platform-computed key for them, and do NOT relax `readonly`: it is what drops a client's write of an engine-stored value.
